title: Build a Pitch Pack for an SEO Agency
summary: From prospect list to evidence brief to a clean CRM, so every SEO pitch is specific and lands in a real inbox.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes you sell SEO retainers; specific pitches can win more paying clients.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Specific audits win more discovery calls than generic offers.
Clean contact data protects your sending reputation.
who_its_for: SEO, AEO and GEO agencies and freelancers.

stack.name: Lead Scout
stack.role: Finds local businesses with likely search gaps.
stack.creator: itsryanlenk

stack.name: Site Research
stack.role: Turns each lead into an evidence-backed gap brief.
stack.creator: itsryanlenk

stack.name: Kickbox to HubSpot Importer
stack.role: Verifies emails and writes the results back to HubSpot.
stack.creator: pofabro

steps.name: Site Research
steps.does: Writes a gap brief for each lead

steps: Pick a niche and a region.
Run Lead Scout, then Site Research on the shortlist.
Verify the contacts with Kickbox and update HubSpot.
Write the pitch around the brief and send it from your own tools.
guardrails: You need your own Kickbox and HubSpot accounts.
Review a sample before any bulk CRM update.
